spans.s:
f. (-टी)
A kind of panick seed, (Panicum italicum,) described as a white variety.

f. (-ली)
A small house lizard: see मुषली; also with कन added, मुशलिका f. (-का.)

r. 1st cl. (मोषति) r. 9th cl. (मुष्णाति)
To steal, to rob, to plunder.
r. 4th cl. (मुष्यति)
1 To cut, to divide, to break.
2 To steal.

f. (-षा)
A crucible.
E.
मुष to steal, aff. अङ् and टाप्, also मूषा.

(इर) मुसिर r. 4th cl. (मुस्यति)
To divide, to cut or break to pieces.

r. 1st cl. (मूषति)
To steal, to rob or plunder.

mf. (-षः-षी-षं)
1 A rat, a mouse.
2 A crucible.
f. (-षा)
A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratum.)
E.
मूष to steal, aff. क.

m. (-कः)
A rat: see मूषक.

mf. (-कः-का-षिका)
1 A mouse, a rat.
2 A thief.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-लः)
1 A club, a mace.
2 A pestle for cleaning rice.
f. (-ली)
1 A house lizard.
2 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides): see मुशली, मुसल, and मुसली.

n. (-लं)
1 A pestle, a wooden pestle used for cleaning rice.
2 A club.
f. (-ली)
1 A plant, (Curculigo orchioides.)
2 A house lizard.
E.
मुस to break, aff. कलच्; it is also read with its compounds and derivatives मुषल, मुषली, and sometimes मुशल, &c.

ind.
Club to club, (fighting, &c.)
E.
मुषल repeated, and इच् added; also मुसलामुमली.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Meriting pounding to death: see मुसल्य.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Deserving death by pounding with a pestle.
E.
मुसल a pestle, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stolen, robbed.
E.
मुष to steal, a. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stolen.
E.
मूष, and क्त, aff.

m. (-ष्कः)
1 The scrotum.
2 The testicle.
3 A heap, a quantity.
4 A thief.
5 A stout man.
6 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali.
E.
मुष to steal, (semen, &c.) कक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali.
E.
मुष्क a thief, (of disease,) and कन् added.

n. (-यं)
The testicles.
E.
मुष्क, and द्वय pair.

m. (-रः)
A man with large testicles.
E.
मुष्क testicle, and रच् aff.

m. (-न्यः)
A eunuch, a guard of the women's apartments.
E.
मुष्क testicle, and शून्य wanting.

n. (-ष्टं)
Theft, robbery.
E.
मुष to steal, aff. क्त, form irr.

mf. (-ष्टिः-ष्टी)
1 The fist, the closed hand.
2 The hilt or handle of a sword, &c.
3 A handful or Pala, the initiatory measure in the tables of the measures of grain.
4 Filching, stealing.
E.
मुष to steal or take, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-कः)
A goldsmith.
E.
मुष्टि stealing, and कृ to make, aff. ड.

m. (-कः)
A name of BALADEVA the brother of KṚṢṆA.

n. (-तं)
A kind of game, odd or even.
E.
मुष्टि the fist, and द्यूत gaming.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Who blows in or on his closed fists.
E.
मुष्टि, and ध्मा to breathe, aff. खच्.

m. (-यः)
A child.
E.
मुष्टि the fist, and धे to drink or suck, aff. खश्.

m. (-तः)
Pummelling, boxing.
E.
मुष्टि, and पात falling.

m. (-न्धः)
Clenching the fist.
E.
मुष्टि the fist, and बन्ध binding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Squeezed, pressed, griped.
E.
मुष्टि, सङ्ग्राह taking, पीडित squeezed.

ind.
Fist to fist, (fighting,) fisticuffs.
E.
मुष्टि repeated in this sense, and the first final made long.

mfn. (-ष्णन्-ष्णन्ती-ष्णत्)
1 Stealing, robbing.
2 Depriving of.
3 Obscuring, eclipsing.
E.
मुष to steal, शतृ aff.

m. (-ली)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
मुसल a pestle, or pestle-like club, used by him as a weapon, and इनि aff.

r. 10th cl. (मुस्तयति)
To accumulate, to collect, to heap together.

mf. (-स्तः-स्ता)
A sort of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
मुस्त to accumulate, aff. अच्.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
2 A sort of poison.
E.
मुस्त to accumulate, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-दः)
A hog.
E.
मुस्ता Cyperus, and अद who eats.

m. (-स्तुः)
The fist.
E.
मुस to break, तुन् aff.

n. (-स्रं)
A pestle.
E.
मुस to divide, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

m. (-तिः)
A cat.
E.
मूषक a rat, and अराति enemy.

n. (-णं)
Stealing, pilfering.
E.
मूष to steal, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Stealing, plundering.
E.
मूष, and शतृ aff.

f. (-र्णी)
An aquatic plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
मूषा a rat, कर्ण the ear; to which the leaf of the plant is compared, fem. aff. ङीष्; also मूषिकपर्णी.

n. (-त्थं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
मूषा a crucible, and तुत्थ sulphate of copper.

mf. (-कः-का)
A rat, a mouse.
m. (-कः)
1 A tree, commonly Siris, (Mimosa sirisha.)
2 A thief, a plunderer.
3 A country, the part of the Malabar coast between Quilon and Cape Comorin.
f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
2 A crucible.
E.
मूष to steal, Uṇādi aff. किनन्, and the vowel made long; also मूषिका, and मूषा, मूषी.

mf. (-कः-का)
A rat, a mouse.
E.
मूष to steal, कीकन् aff.

f. (-र्णी)
An aquatic plant of the cryptogamia class (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
मूषिक a rat, (ears, understood,) and पर्णी a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having a leaf compared to a mouse's ear.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
मूषिक a rat, and अङ्क a mark or emblem; being usually painted riding on a rat or attended by one.

m. (-नः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
मूषिक a rat, and अञ्चन going.

m. (-तिः)
A cat.
E.
मूषिक, and अराति an enemy.

m. (-यः)
A plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)
E.
मूषिक a rat, and आह्वय appellation; also मूषिकाह्व.

f. (-का)
A plant: see the last.
E.
मूषि for मूषी, and कन् added to पर्णी.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Born of unknown parents, of concealed birth or origin.
E.
अमूष्यायण the son of somebody, and the initiatory vowel rejected.
